reviews.author: RyanO

reviews.title: Bought instead of Studio Display
reviews.comment: I had wanted to buy an Apple display for very long to use with my MBP, but I thought 5K was unnecessary and the price too high. I decided to get a high refresh rate monitor to match my positive experience with ProMotion on my MBP, and this was the best choice because of its perfect compatibility with it. It's very practical to have my Mac docked to the monitor and take it out fully charged. I regret not getting the glass model because there is a difference between my Mac screen, but I might buy a second monitor of that model.
reviews.author: JackH

reviews.title: Great for both gaming and work
reviews.comment: A little bit skeptical as I have not heard of the brand but took a chance on the glass when it's on sale. Love the minimalist look and how the screen is much more vibrant sitting next to my Dell monitor due to the glass screen. Pair really well with my new Mac Mini M4 and PlayStation. Pleased with this purchase!
reviews.author: NinaV

reviews.title: Defective two years ago and still defective today
reviews.comment: Bought this monitor 18 moths ago and returned cause it was defective. Game those guys another chance this week, thinking "for sure after 18 months all problems have been fixed, right? right??" - Nope. Monitor arrived with a *completely* dead OSD to the point not even the power button worked. I used it for a few hours until I noticed it, and during that time experienced tons of black screens. Returned immediately. Best buy should stop doing business with those guys.
